reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 4 recyclers trading the same material (36% of its feedstock)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 92% of months
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 1 other plant(s)
Category III share of certificates is 54%, +52% versus what its process route can produce
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.61x the cost floor)
Shares a bank account with 3 other registered entity(ies)

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
